channel.title: Bill Whalen solution journal
channel.description: Customer-neutral public solution entries and illustrated build notes.

item.title: One local control surface, explicit sensitive-action gates
item.description: A self-hosted React and TypeScript reference build that combines native Home Assistant cards with custom estate controls on a shared connection and layout. Designed value: a coherent self-hosted estate view with selective live updates, reusable Home Assistant cards, and confirmation before security-reducing actions.

item.title: Turn freight exceptions into owned work
item.description: A public sample-data browser prototype that models freight email triage as owned, visible work with queue, aging, detail, and resolution views. Designed value: a shared queue for freight exceptions with clearer ownership, aging, priority, and resolution state.

item.title: Prototype the reading experience before the ingestion service
item.description: An explicitly unpublished static reference interface for exploring how sample product updates could be filtered, scanned, and opened as a digest. Designed value: a filterable reference pattern for turning a broad product-update stream into a more focused, reviewable digest.

item.title: Bring the surrounding record into the work
item.description: An adaptive Dynamics 365 and Dataverse web resource that brings related operational context into the forms where work already happens. Designed value: less navigation between related records and a more coherent operational view at the point of work.

item.title: Making multi-agent work visible
item.description: A configurable generator and template set for scaffolding specialized AI agent roles around a visible GitHub Issues work queue and outcome gates. Designed value: clearer ownership, inspectable handoffs, and human-visible outcome gates for multi-agent work.

item.title: Keep claims assistance separate from claims authority
item.description: A Power Platform accelerator for structuring warranty and claims intake, review, supporting flows, and human-owned decisions. Designed value: more consistent claims intake and review with visible status, supporting context, and human-owned decisions.

item.title: Teach prompting as a team sport
item.description: A multiplayer prompt-engineering escape room that turns clearer instructions, constraints, iteration, and creativity into a playable team challenge. Designed value: an experiential way for teams to practice clearer prompts, constraints, iteration, and collaborative problem solving.

item.title: A seller workflow demo is not an autonomous agent system
item.description: A single-commit hackathon MVP that visualizes a deterministic, agent-styled seller workflow from voice or text input through CRM, illustrative attainment, recognition, and simulated notification stages. Designed value: a tangible visualization of how one seller update could pass through structured CRM, calculation, recognition, and notification stages.

item.title: Use a tiny tool to see the whole MCP path
item.description: A hands-on public lab for deploying a small Model Context Protocol tool server and adding it as a tool in Microsoft Copilot Studio. Designed value: a compact end-to-end MCP reference that makes server, tool, client, and invocation responsibilities easier to see.
